quizTitle: Modals of Obligation: Present and Past in Companies

questions.question: Employees ___ follow the company’s safety rules at all times.
Managers ___ approve overtime requests before employees work extra hours.
Staff ___ submit monthly reports to finance by the deadline to avoid delays.
The team ___ tested the software before rollout; the crash could have been prevented.
Someone ___ informed the team about the schedule change; that’s why no one attended the meeting.
The HR manager ___ processed leave requests yesterday; payroll ran smoothly.
All employees ___ use their ID cards to access restricted areas, unless they have temporary clearance.
The finance team ___ spotted the missing invoice; that’s why the client wasn’t charged incorrectly.
Employees ___ log out from their accounts when leaving the office, especially on shared computers.
Someone ___ sent the wrong file; the client received outdated information by mistake.
The IT team ___ installed the security update, but the system still had vulnerabilities.
Employees ___ report harassment incidents immediately; delay could worsen the situation.
The assistant ___ arranged the meeting room correctly; the double booking was an exception.
Staff ___ confirmed all travel arrangements before departure, unless changes were last minute.
Employees ___ complete annual ethics training; new hires may have extra onboarding sessions.
Someone ___ sent the wrong email; the client received confusing instructions.
Managers ___ review all expense reports before approving payment; exceptions may exist for low-value items.
The team ___ tested the new feature thoroughly; otherwise, bugs would have appeared.
Employees ___ wear protective equipment in the warehouse, unless they are in the visitor area.
Someone ___ deleted the wrong document; it may have been accidental.
